patterns.note: Content is primarily centered within a maximum width, with full-width sections used for large headings and background elements, creating a balanced and focused reading experience.
Large, bold, sans-serif headings are used for section titles, creating strong visual hierarchy, contrasted with smaller, lighter body text and italicized placeholder text.
A minimalist palette of near-white backgrounds and dark text is accented by vibrant, multi-color illustrations and UI elements within the product mockups, adding a playful energy.

As the user scrolls, a header with navigation becomes sticky and gains a subtle backdrop blur. A download prompt with a QR code and platform buttons slides in from the left, remaining fixed. The hero section transforms from a placeholder to a dynamic product screen. A horizontal scrollable section of product cards is revealed at the bottom of the page.
Feature sections are introduced with large, declarative headings and often showcase product capabilities through card-based layouts or interactive mockups.

technique_notes: To rebuild the motion system, implement a sticky header that appears or transforms on scroll, applying a backdrop blur effect. Create a fixed-position download prompt that slides into view from the side after a certain scroll depth. For the hero, use a scroll-triggered animation to swap a static placeholder with a dynamic video or canvas-based product simulation. Implement scroll-triggered reveals for content sections, potentially using staggered fade-up or slide-in effects for individual elements. Finally, create a horizontally scrollable container for a series of cards at the bottom of the page, activated by vertical scroll.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) create strong visual anchors, complemented by a clean, readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Rounded corners are consistently applied to buttons, input fields, cards, and UI elements, conveying a soft and approachable aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy spacing is used in the hero and between major sections, providing ample breathing room, while content within cards and forms maintains a balanced density.

standout: The site's distinctive blend of a clean, minimal aesthetic with a playful, widget-based product interface and interactive download prompt creates a unique and engaging experience. The focus on 'weird little spaces' and 'making space fun' sets a lighthearted, community-oriented tone that feels fresh.
